_meta.description: Phase 17 SWITCH baseline. Gate tests: T6 x 35B/122B, W1/W2 x 35B, T1/T5 canaries, B2 x 35B/122B regression status.

T6_35b.note: Post-17-03 SWITCH. 4 steps typical: read_file + grep_search + read_file (targeted) + final. Gate fails if >5.

T6_122b.note: Post-17-03 SWITCH. 4 steps typical: double grep_search + read_file + final. Gate fails if >5.

W2_35b.note: Same as W1: loop-injection holds 3 steps.

T1_35b.note: Canary. 1 step typical; 3 steps observed once in prior variance. 4+ = alarm.

B2_35b.actual_diagnosis: empty list causes DivideByZeroException — 'The bug is in the average function which performs integer division by List.length xs without checking if the list is empty. When an empty list is passed, List.length returns 0, causing a DivideByZeroException at runtime.'
B2_35b.note: Phase 17-03 SWITCH. 2 steps: read_file + final. Diagnosis accuracy confirmed.

B2_122b.actual_diagnosis: empty list causes DivideByZeroException — 'The bug is a division by zero when the input list is empty, because List.length [] returns 0, and dividing by zero raises a DivideByZeroException.'
B2_122b.note: Phase 17-03 SWITCH. 2 steps: read_file + final. Diagnosis accuracy confirmed.
